# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Do not open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Report them privately, either:

- through GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Maxim-Dubreil/CinePick/security/advisories/new),
  or
- by email to maxim.dubreil@epitech.eu.

Please include a description of the issue, steps to reproduce, and its potential impact.

You will get an acknowledgement within 7 days. Please do not disclose the issue publicly until a
fix has been released.

## Supported versions

Only the latest version deployed from the `main` branch receives security fixes.
